g.text: Spring activity amount and spatial first harmonic
Exact per-case/time identity; population mean R is the mean paired product, not the product of separate means.
All 81 native cases; scalar cadence 0.5, field checks every 4; shared row scales; pointwise 95% seed intervals for noisy groups only.
